raw:
The user is asking me to write UI strings for a desktop app in Traditional Chinese. The screen is when a desktop application detects a new version available for installation.

They want:
- "s1": notification title
- "s2": notification body (one sentence)
- "s3": "install now" button

They only want a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, values as strings, no other text.

Let me write good Traditional Chinese strings:

s1: Something like "有新版本可用" or "發現新版本" — notification title
s2: One sentence body, like "新版本 v1.2.3 已準備好，立即安裝以獲得最新功能與修正。" But they said one sentence, keep it concise. Maybe "目前使用的是舊版本，立即更新以享有最新功能與安全性修正。" Or simpler: "偵測到新版本，建議盡快安裝以獲得最佳體驗。"
s3: "立即安裝" — button for install now

Traditional Chinese (Taiwan style) — "立即安裝" is appropriate. Title could be "有新版本可用" or "新版本已推出".

Let me finalize:
s1: "有可用的新版本"
s2: "偵測到新版本，立即更新即可享有最新功能與修正。"
s3: "立即安裝"

Actually for s2, one sentence is fine. Output only JSON, no markdown code fences? They said "只輸出一個 JSON 物件...不要其他文字" — best to output raw JSON without code fences to comply strictly. Though code fences might be considered other text. I'll output pure JSON.

JSON with Traditional Chinese strings:

{"s1": "有可用的新版本", "s2": "偵測到新版本，立即更新即可享有最新功能與錯誤修正。", "s3": "立即安裝"}

Hmm, "錯誤修正" vs "問題修正" — "bug 修正" is common but mixing English. "修正" alone works. Let me use: "偵測到新版本，立即更新以獲得最新功能與改善。"

Keep s2 as one sentence: "偵測到新版本，立即更新即可體驗最新功能與改進。"{"s1": "有可用的新版本", "s2": "偵測到新版本，立即更新即可享受最新功能與改善。", "s3": "立即安裝"}
